These are authored, fictional Vietnamese fixtures, not downloaded publisher pages.
`public_article.html` tests the explicitly configured `article.news-body` selector,
Unicode text and removal of navigation, scripts, adverts and related content.
`missing_body.html` represents a missing public article container.

All committed real sources have article extraction disabled. Before enabling one,
record its permission/public path scope, check robots rules and verify a selector
against permitted saved HTML. These fixtures do not establish live compatibility
with any publisher.
